rationale: Iris melanoma is an anterior uveal melanoma of the iris; in ICD-O the iris is coded with the ciliary body (C694). Restricted to this ocular site.

subset_sites: Bones of skull and face and associated joints

subset_sites: Bones of skull and face and associated joints

subset_sites: Bones of skull and face and associated joints

subset_sites: Bones of skull and face and associated joints
